verdict.rationale: Zulip's official API and bot framework let an agent read and post channel messages (send-message endpoint, bot API keys, Botserver deployment for production bots), which functionally supports the story. However, the evidence never explicitly documents fine-grained 'scoped tokens' (e.g., channel-restricted or read/write-limited permissions) — only generic bot API keys — and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this API usage pattern. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of token scoping/permission granularity, independent verification of API reliability for agent use cases.
